explicit_paper_parameters.force_equations: Eq31: nominal U^2 dynamic pressure; Eq32: linearized flow deviation from (vertical velocity + R*torsional velocity)/U; Eq33: rotate lift and drag into structural directions, including drag vertical projection.

not_specified_by_paper: A or EA; do not infer solid circular area from the bare aerodynamic diameter.

Initial tension, sag, reference lengths, installation stress and prestress procedure; rated tensile strength is not initial tension.
Mesh size, integration and mass-matrix details.
Full support DOFs, especially torsional constraints; initial local axes and mass-first-moment sign.
Full initial displacement and velocity, perturbation, wind startup and gravity/wind prebalance procedure.
Damping matrix construction, fitting frequencies and update policy.
Air density, precise diameter/radius use in aerodynamics, moment sign and load integration convention.
Fifth-order coefficient values, degree/radian implementation and treatment outside 0 to 100 degrees.
Original raw reference trajectories and exact initial torsion. The dense Fig10 curve near 0.164 rad does not establish theta(0)=0.164 rad.

current_main_test_vs_paper_limits: 300 s只覆盖论文2000 s历程的前段，不能要求已达到论文t>1000 s的稳定轨迹。
本轮比较Newmark的两种时间步策略，论文比较的是A-TSSBN与SDIRK；论文性能表不能作为Newmark的速度真值。
正式完整相对风与论文名义U、线性流偏近似不逐式相同；正式CSV插值也不等于论文未公开五次拟合。
A、初张力、总线质量解释、空气密度和初态必须作为补充假设登记，不能宣称严格Fig10复现。
论文使用4DOF索，梁是派生离散对照。当前CR梁未完整支持索的一次质量矩及偏心重力耦合；索梁物理耦合不完全相同，不可把差异全部归因于时间积分。
计算完整结束只证明求解完成。舞动仍须按分窗振幅、增长、持续性及速度/扭转响应检查；无阻尼或风阶跃暂态不能自动认定舞动。
此前171.5度、GJ140等成功舞动结果为另一派生工况，本轮不得替代40度论文条件。
